name: aes
description: AES — Ank Ecosystem Social. A mini social platform on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Backblaze B2

scripts.dev: npm run build:assets && wrangler dev --env local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8787
scripts.build:assets: npm run build:css && npm run build:client
scripts.build: npm run bundle:migrations && npm run build:assets && npm run typecheck
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply ank-social --env local --local
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply ank-social --env preview --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run bundle:migrations && npm run build:assets && wrangler d1 migrations apply ank-social --env= --remote && wrangler deploy --env=
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
